collab.copyFailed: The copy failed: select the text in the editor.

statusBar.formatJsonTooltip: Indent the JSON block under the cursor

imageUpload.notInserted: The image “{name}” was not inserted: this tab has no access to the shared draft.
imageUpload.type: The studio accepts images in the formats {formats}.
imageUpload.size: The image weighs {size} MB, over the {limit} MB limit.
imageUpload.content: The content of the file does not match its extension or is not a readable image.

json.invalidLeft: Invalid JSON block left as is | {n} invalid JSON blocks left as is
json.tourFormatted: JSON block of a JsonTour formatted | {n} JSON blocks of JsonTour formatted
json.tourZonesMoved: The lines named by the ::Zone may have moved.

frontmatter.invalidYaml: Unreadable front matter line: write one key per line, as key: value.
frontmatter.quoteValue: Put a value that holds “:” between quotes: {line}
frontmatter.quoteValueShort: Line {line}: value to put between quotes
frontmatter.unclosed: Open front matter: add a --- line above this heading to close it.
frontmatter.unclosedShort: Line {line}: front matter to close with ---
frontmatter.unknownKey: Unknown key: check the spelling of “{key}” in the suggestions ({keys}).
frontmatter.invalidValue: Value refused: pick a value in the suggestions ({keys}).

expected.number: Value refused: this key takes a number, such as 1280.
expected.boolean: Value refused: this key takes true or false.
expected.string: Value refused: this key takes a text.

frontmatter.unknownTheme: Unknown theme: pick a theme among {themes}.
frontmatter.themeVersionGap: The theme “{theme}” was published with another version of the theme engine than this studio's: the preview and the presentation can differ from the intended rendering. Ask an owner of the instance to publish it again.

diagnostics.unknownComponent: Unknown component: check the name “{name}” in the help. The preview shows its content without formatting.
diagnostics.parseFailed: The preview shows the last readable version: undo your last change and redo it in small steps.
diagnostics.renderFailed: The preview shows the slide without the component “{name}”, which could not render: check its attributes in the help.
diagnostics.refusedUrl: Address refused: write an address that starts with https://, or a path of this site that starts with /.
diagnostics.refusedBinding: Attribute refused: after “:”, write true, false, a number or a text between quotes, and remove v-bind, v-on, {'@'} and v-model.
diagnostics.refusedEmbed: http:// address: the browser blocks this frame, image or video in the studio. Write the address with https://, or with http://localhost for a server on your computer.
diagnostics.overflow: The content of slide {slide} is taller than the slide: the presentation and the PDF cut what reaches below. Shorten it or spread it over two slides.
diagnostics.overflowShort: Slide {slide}: content cut at the bottom
diagnostics.imageMissing: Image not found at {src}: check the address, or paste the image into the text to upload it to the studio.

malformedAttributes.brace: Add the {'}'} brace that closes the attributes of “{name}”.
malformedAttributes.quote: Add the " quote that closes a value of “{name}”.
malformedAttributes.typographic: Replace the « » or “ ” quotes in the attributes of “{name}” with straight quotes ".

diagnostics.unclosedBlock: Component {colons}{name} open to the end of the text: add a {colons} line after its content. Without it, the slides that follow go into this component.
diagnostics.attributeUnknown: Unknown attribute of {component}: “{name}”. Hover the name of the component to see its attributes.
diagnostics.attributeFalseText: {name}="false" is read as a text, so as true: write :{name}="false".
diagnostics.attributeNoValue: “{name}” has no value: {component} ignores it. Write {name}="…".
diagnostics.layoutUnknownAttribute: Unknown :layout attribute: “{name}”. Pick an attribute from the help.
diagnostics.layoutInvalidValue: Unknown value for “{name}”. Pick a value from the help.
diagnostics.layoutMissingSource: Media without an address: add the src or story attribute.
diagnostics.layoutUnused: Remove “{name}”: this attribute has no effect with this placement of the media.
diagnostics.layoutBehindNeedsImage: Behind the text, the media is an image: enter its address in src.
diagnostics.layoutBehindNeedsImageShort: Line {line}: image required behind the text

properties.none: Place the cursor in a component or an annotation to set its attributes.

layout.proposeBody: Place the media to the right of the text, on {size} of the width.
layout.sizeFits: The text fits with the media on {size} of the width.
layout.tooLong: The text overflows at every size: shorten it or split the slide.
